sources.title: Arm employee: Clean and Invalidate Cache Memory
sources.relevance: Clean writes dirty cached data; invalidate discards cache hits; these are not interchangeable
sources.limitation: Must establish ownership/alignment/current cache state before selecting a maintenance operation
